AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
On-device AI chat client with LLM inference, agent tools, and MCP support.
Operational Patterns: - Always call 'listConversations' to find existing conversation IDs before calling 'sendChatMessage' to reuse an existing conversation. - Create a new conversation with 'createConversation' for unrelated topics to keep context separate. - Use 'searchConversations' to find conversations about a specific topic before asking a new question.
Constraints: - sendChatMessage may take up to 120 seconds to generate a response. - conversationId strings must be UUID format (e.g., from listConversations or createConversation).
